item.title: Celebrate George Washington’s Birthday at Washington Crossing Historic Park
item.description: Washington Crossing Historic Park in Pennsylvania would not miss George Washington’s 294th birthday! The park is celebrating on February 15 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a family-friendly event featuring hands-on activities for kids including Quill Pen Writing, Whirly-Gig Game Making, and a soldiers’ drill.
